H.name: HYDROGEN
H.desc: DA LIGHTEST AN' MOST ABUNDANT ELEMENT IN DA UNIVERSE, FORMIN' STARS AN' WATER ALIKE. A COLORLESS, HIGHLY FLAMMABLE GAS AT STANDARD CONDITIONS!

He.name: HELIUM
He.desc: A NOBLE GAS PRODUCED BY NUCLEAR FUSION IN STARS AN' ACCUMULATED IN NATURAL GAS DEPOSITS. COLORLESS, ODORLESS, AN' DA SECOND MOST ABUNDANT ELEMENT IN DA UNIVERSE!

Li.name: LITHIUM
Li.desc: DA LIGHTEST OF ALL METALS, SOFT ENOUGH TA CUT WIT A KNIFE. REACTS VIGOROUSLY WIT WATER AN' IZ DA BACKBONE OF MODERN RECHARGEABLE BATTERIES!

Be.name: BERYLLIUM
Be.desc: AN EXCEPTIONALLY STIFF, LIGHTWEIGHT METAL USED IN AEROSPACE ALLOYS AN' X-RAY WINDOWS. TOXIC IF INHALED AS DUST, BUT INVALUABLE IN PRECISION ENGINEERIN'!

B.name: BORON
B.desc: A METALLOID ESSENTIAL FOR PLANT CELL WALLS AN' USED IN GLASS, CERAMICS, AN' NUCLEAR REACTORS AS A NEUTRON ABSORBER!

C.name: CARBON
C.desc: DA BACKBONE OF ALL KNOWN ORGANIC CHEMISTRY, CARBON FORMS MORE COMPOUNDS DEN ANY OTHER ELEMENT. FROM DIAMONDS TA GRAPHITE TA LIFE ITSELF, ITS VERSATILITY IZ UNMATCHED!

N.name: NITROGEN
N.desc: COMPRISIN' 78% OF EARTH'S ATMOSPHERE, NITROGEN IZ ESSENTIAL FOR PROTEINS, DNA, AN' ALL LIVIN' ORGANISMS, YET ITS PURE FORM IZ CHEMICALLY INERT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE!

O.name: OXYGEN
O.desc: DA BREATH OF LIFE AN' DA FUEL OF COMBUSTION. OXYGEN COMPRISES 21% OF EARTH'S ATMOSPHERE AN' IZ DA MOST ABUNDANT ELEMENT IN DA EARTH'S CRUST BY MASS!

F.name: FLUORINE
F.desc: DA MOST ELECTRONEGATIVE AN' REACTIVE ELEMENT, CAPABLE OF FORMIN' COMPOUNDS WIT ALMOST EVERY OTHER ELEMENT INCLUDIN' NOBLE GASES. A PALE YELLOW, CORROSIVE GAS!

Ne.name: NEON
Ne.desc: A NOBLE GAS FAMOUS FOR ITS BRILLIANT ORANGE-RED EMISSION IN DISCHARGE TUBES. COMPLETELY CHEMICALLY INERT AN' DA FIFTH MOST ABUNDANT ELEMENT IN DA UNIVERSE!

Na.name: SODIUM
Na.desc: A SOFT, SILVERY-WHITE ALKALI METAL DAT REACTS VIOLENTLY WIT WATER. ESSENTIAL FOR NERVE TRANSMISSION AN' DA REGULATION OF BLOOD PRESSURE IN LIVIN' ORGANISMS!

Mg.name: MAGNESIUM
Mg.desc: A LIGHTWEIGHT STRUCTURAL METAL DAT BURNS WIT A DAZZLIN' WHITE FLAME. ESSENTIAL FOR CHLOROPHYLL IN PLANTS AN' OVER 300 ENZYMATIC REACTIONS IN DA HUMAN BODY!

Al.name: ALUMINUM
Al.desc: DA MOST ABUNDANT METAL IN EARTH'S CRUST, PRIZED FOR ITS LOW DENSITY, CORROSION RESISTANCE, AN' RECYCLABILITY. DA FOUNDATION OF DA MODERN AEROSPACE INDUSTRY!

Si.name: SILICON
Si.desc: DA SECOND MOST ABUNDANT ELEMENT IN EARTH'S CRUST AN' DA BACKBONE OF MODERN ELECTRONICS. SILICON'S SEMICONDUCTOR PROPERTIES UNDERPIN VIRTUALLY ALL DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY!

P.name: PHOSPHORUS
P.desc: ESSENTIAL FOR LIFE IN DNA, RNA, AN' ATP ENERGY TRANSFER. EXISTS IN SEVERAL ALLOTROPES RANGIN' FROM DA WAXY WHITE FORM TA DA STABLE RED VARIETY USED IN MATCHES!

S.name: SULFUR
S.desc: A BRIGHT YELLOW SOLID KNOWN AN' USED SINCE ANTIQUITY IN MEDICINE AN' ALCHEMY. ESSENTIAL IN PROTEINS AN' A KEY INDUSTRIAL CHEMICAL USED IN FERTILIZERS AN' RUBBER VULCANIZATION!

Cl.name: CHLORINE
Cl.desc: A YELLOW-GREEN, ACRID GAS USED IN WATER PURIFICATION AN' CHEMICAL SYNTHESIS. FORMS COMMON TABLE SALT WIT SODIUM AN' WAZ TRAGICALLY USED AS A CHEMICAL WEAPON IN WWI!

Ar.name: ARGON
Ar.desc: DA MOST ABUNDANT NOBLE GAS IN EARTH'S ATMOSPHERE AT NEARLY 1%. USED AS AN INERT SHIELDIN' GAS IN WELDIN' AN' TA FILL INCANDESCENT LIGHT BULBS!

K.name: POTASSIUM
K.desc: AN ESSENTIAL NUTRIENT FOR EVERY ANIMAL CELL, REGULATIN' FLUID BALANCE AN' NERVE FUNCTION. REACTS EXPLOSIVELY WIT WATER, IGNITIN' WIT A CHARACTERISTIC VIOLET FLAME!

Ca.name: CALCIUM
Ca.desc: DA MOST ABUNDANT MINERAL IN DA HUMAN BODY, FORMIN' DA STRUCTURAL FOUNDATION OF BONES AN' TEETH. ALSO ESSENTIAL FOR MUSCLE CONTRACTION AN' BLOOD CLOTTIN'!

Sc.name: SCANDIUM
Sc.desc: A RARE TRANSITION METAL WHOSE LIGHT WEIGHT AN' HIGH MELTIN' POINT MAKE IT VALUABLE IN AEROSPACE ALLOYS AN' HIGH-INTENSITY METAL HALIDE LAMPS!

Ti.name: TITANIUM
Ti.desc: CELEBRATED FOR ITS EXCEPTIONAL STRENGTH-TA-WEIGHT RATIO AN' TOTAL CORROSION RESISTANCE. BIOCOMPATIBLE WIT HUMAN TISSUE, IT IZ DA METAL OF CHOICE FOR SURGICAL IMPLANTS AN' JET ENGINES!

V.name: VANADIUM
V.desc: A HARD, SILVERY-GREY METAL DAT DRAMATICALLY INCREASES STEEL'S STRENGTH AN' TOUGHNESS IN SMALL QUANTITIES. AN ESSENTIAL TRACE ELEMENT IN CERTAIN METABOLIC ENZYMES!

Cr.name: CHROMIUM
Cr.desc: DA ELEMENT DAT MAKES STAINLESS STEEL STAINLESS. ITS NAME COMES FROM DA GREEK FOR COLOR, AS ITS COMPOUNDS PRODUCE VIVID REDS, GREENS, AN' YELLOWS IN PIGMENTS AN' GEMSTONES!

Mn.name: MANGANESE
Mn.desc: AN ESSENTIAL ELEMENT IN STEEL PRODUCTION, HARDENIN' IRON ALLOYS AN' PREVENTIN' BRITTLENESS. ALSO A CRITICAL TRACE ELEMENT IN BONE FORMATION AN' ANTIOXIDANT ENZYMES!

Fe.name: IRON
Fe.desc: DA MOST WIDELY USED METAL IN HUMAN HISTORY, AN' DA DOMINANT ELEMENT OF EARTH'S CORE. DA BASIS OF STEEL AN' DA BACKBONE OF INDUSTRIAL CIVILIZATION!

Co.name: COBALT
Co.desc: NAMED AFTER DA KOBOLD OF GERMAN MININ' FOLKLORE. ITS BRILLIANT BLUE COMPOUNDS HAB COLORED GLASS AN' CERAMICS FOR MILLENNIA, AN' IT IZ ESSENTIAL IN SUPERALLOYS FOR JET ENGINES!

Ni.name: NICKEL
Ni.desc: A SHINY, CORROSION-RESISTANT METAL COMMON IN COINAGE AN' STAINLESS STEEL. NAMED AFTER DA DEVIL OF GERMAN LEGEND, AS EARLY MINERS CURSED DA ORE DAT YIELDED NO COPPER!

Cu.name: COPPER
Cu.desc: ONE OF DA FIRST METALS EVER SMELTED BY HUMANITY. DA BEST METALLIC CONDUCTOR OF ELECTRICITY AN' HEAT AFTER SILVER, AN' DA DEFININ' ELEMENT OF DA BRONZE AGE!

Zn.name: ZINC
Zn.desc: USED TA GALVANIZE STEEL AGAINST CORROSION AN' AS A DIETARY ESSENTIAL FOR IMMUNE FUNCTION AN' WOUND HEALIN'. DA OXIDE FORMS A WHITE PROTECTIVE LAYER UPON OXIDATION!

Ga.name: GALLIUM
Ga.desc: A SOFT METAL DAT MELTS IN DA WARMTH OF A HUMAN HAND AT JUST 30°C. USED EXTENSIVELY IN SEMICONDUCTORS, LEDS, AN' SOLAR CELLS, AN' REMARKABLE FOR ITS EXPANSION UPON SOLIDIFYIN'!

Ge.name: GERMANIUM
Ge.desc: PREDICTED BY MENDELEEV BEFORE ITS DISCOVERY AS EKA-SILICON. A SEMICONDUCTOR OF HISTORICAL IMPORTANCE, NOW USED IN INFRARED OPTICS AN' FIBER OPTIC CABLES!

As.name: ARSENIC
As.desc: A TOXIC METALLOID WIT A LONG AN' DARK HISTORY AS BOTH A POISON AN' A MEDICINE. USED INDUSTRIALLY IN SEMICONDUCTORS AN' WOOD PRESERVATIVES DESPITE ITS NOTORIOUS TOXICITY!

Se.name: SELENIUM
Se.desc: ESSENTIAL FOR THYROID HORMONE METABOLISM AN' ANTIOXIDANT FUNCTION IN TRACE AMOUNTS, YET TOXIC IN EXCESS. GIVES A RED COLOR TA GLASS AN' CONVERTS LIGHT TA ELECTRICITY IN PHOTOCELLS!

Br.name: BROMINE
Br.desc: ONE OF ONLY TWO ELEMENTS LIQUID AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. A DEEP REDDISH-BROWN LIQUID WIT A SHARP, CHOKIN' ODOR, USED IN FLAME RETARDANTS AN' HISTORICALLY IN PHOTOGRAPHY!

Kr.name: KRYPTON
Kr.desc: A NOBLE GAS USED IN HIGH-POWERED FLASH LAMPS FOR PHOTOGRAPHY AN' CERTAIN LASER APPLICATIONS. FORMERLY DEFINED DA LENGTH OF DA METER VIA A SPECIFIC SPECTRAL LINE!

Rb.name: RUBIDIUM
Rb.desc: A SOFT, SILVERY ALKALI METAL DAT IGNITES SPONTANEOUSLY UPON CONTACT WIT AIR AN' REACTS EXPLOSIVELY WIT WATER. USED IN ATOMIC CLOCKS AN' CERTAIN SPECIALTY GLASSES!

Sr.name: STRONTIUM
Sr.desc: AN ALKALINE EARTH METAL DAT GIVES FIREWORKS AN' FLARES DEY BRILLIANT CRIMSON COLOR. ITS RADIOACTIVE ISOTOPE STRONTIUM-90 IZ A HAZARDOUS NUCLEAR FISSION BYPRODUCT!

Y.name: YTTRIUM
Y.desc: NAMED AFTER YTTERBY, SWEDEN, DA VILLAGE DAT YIELDED FOUR NEW ELEMENTS. USED IN RED PHOSPHORS FOR TELEVISION SCREENS AN' HIGH-TEMPERATURE SUPERCONDUCTORS!

Zr.name: ZIRCONIUM
Zr.desc: EXTREMELY RESISTANT TA CORROSION IN ALMOST ALL ENVIRONMENTS. ITS NEAR-TOTAL TRANSPARENCY TA NEUTRONS MAKES IT DA STANDARD CLADDIN' MATERIAL FOR NUCLEAR FUEL RODS!

Nb.name: NIOBIUM
Nb.desc: A SUPERCONDUCTOR AT LOW TEMPERATURES, INDISPENSABLE IN MRI MAGNETS AN' PARTICLE ACCELERATORS. ADDED IN SMALL AMOUNTS TA STEEL, IT DRAMATICALLY INCREASES STRENGTH AN' TOUGHNESS!

Mo.name: MOLYBDENUM
Mo.desc: HAB ONE OF DA HIGHEST MELTIN' POINTS OF ALL ELEMENTS. A CRITICAL ALLOYIN' AGENT IN HIGH-STRENGTH STEELS AN' AN ESSENTIAL COFACTOR IN DA ENZYME DAT FIXES ATMOSPHERIC NITROGEN!

Tc.name: TECHNETIUM
Tc.desc: DA FIRST ELEMENT TA BE SYNTHESIZED ARTIFICIALLY. ITS METASTABLE ISOMER TECHNETIUM-99M IZ DA MOST WIDELY USED RADIOISOTOPE IN NUCLEAR MEDICINE FOR DIAGNOSTIC IMAGIN'!

Ru.name: RUTHENIUM
Ru.desc: A RARE PLATINUM-GROUP METAL OF EXTRAORDINARY HARDNESS USED IN ELECTRICAL CONTACTS, CATALYSIS, AN' AS AN ALLOYIN' AGENT TA HARDEN PLATINUM AN' PALLADIUM!

Rh.name: RHODIUM
Rh.desc: AMONG DA RAREST AN' MOST VALUABLE STABLE METALS ON EARTH. ITS PRIMARY USE IZ IN CATALYTIC CONVERTERS, WHERE IT REDUCES NITROGEN OXIDES IN VEHICLE EXHAUST!

Pd.name: PALLADIUM
Pd.desc: CAN ABSORB UP TA 900 TIMES ITS OWN VOLUME OF HYDROGEN, MAKIN' IT A KEY CATALYST IN HYDROGENATION REACTIONS AN' AN IMPORTANT COMPONENT OF CATALYTIC CONVERTERS!

Ag.name: SILVER
Ag.desc: DA BEST ELECTRICAL AN' THERMAL CONDUCTOR OF ALL ELEMENTS. PRIZED SINCE ANTIQUITY FOR COINAGE, JEWELRY, AN' TABLEWARE, AN' NOW ESSENTIAL IN ELECTRONICS AN' PHOTOGRAPHY!

Cd.name: CADMIUM
Cd.desc: A SOFT, BLUISH-WHITE METAL USED IN NICKEL-CADMIUM RECHARGEABLE BATTERIES AN' CADMIUM YELLOW PIGMENTS. HIGHLY TOXIC AN' A SIGNIFICANT ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARD FROM INDUSTRIAL WASTE!

In.name: INDIUM
In.desc: A SOFT, SILVERY POST-TRANSITION METAL INDISPENSABLE IN DA TRANSPARENT CONDUCTIN' COATIN' OF LCD TOUCHSCREENS, FLAT PANEL DISPLAYS, AN' THIN-FILM SOLAR CELLS!

Sn.name: TIN
Sn.desc: KNOWN AN' SMELTED SINCE ANTIQUITY, TIN FORMS DA CLASSIC ALLOYS BRONZE (WIT COPPER) AN' PEWTER. AT REAL LOW TEMPERATURES IT UNDERGOES A DESTRUCTIVE PHASE CHANGE CALLED TIN PEST!

Sb.name: ANTIMONY
Sb.desc: A BRITTLE METALLOID KNOWN SINCE ANCIENT EGYPT, USED TA HARDEN LEAD IN AMMUNITION AN' BATTERIES. ITS SULFIDE WAZ USED AS KOHL EYE COSMETIC IN DA ANCIENT WORLD!

Te.name: TELLURIUM
Te.desc: ONE OF DA RAREST STABLE ELEMENTS IN EARTH'S CRUST, YET ESSENTIAL IN SOLAR CELLS, THERMOELECTRIC DEVICES, AN' AS AN ALLOYIN' AGENT TA IMPROVE STEEL MACHINABILITY!

I.name: IODINE
I.desc: ESSENTIAL FOR THYROID HORMONES DAT REGULATE METABOLISM IN VERTEBRATES. ITS VAPOR FORMS A DISTINCTIVE PURPLE CLOUD, AN' IT WAZ FIRST ISOLATED FROM SEAWEED IN 1811!

Xe.name: XENON
Xe.desc: A NOBLE GAS USED IN POWERFUL STROBOSCOPIC LAMPS, ION THRUSTERS FOR SPACECRAFT, AN' AS A GENERAL ANESTHETIC. FORMS SURPRISINGLY STABLE COMPOUNDS WIT FLUORINE AN' OXYGEN!

Cs.name: CESIUM
Cs.desc: DA MOST REACTIVE OF ALL STABLE ALKALI METALS, IGNITIN' INSTANTLY IN AIR. ITS HYPERFINE TRANSITION FREQUENCY DEFINES DA SI SECOND, MAKIN' IT DA BASIS OF ATOMIC TIME!

Ba.name: BARIUM
Ba.desc: A DENSE, SOFT ALKALINE EARTH METAL WHOSE COMPOUNDS CREATE DA VIVID GREEN COLOR IN FIREWORKS. INSOLUBLE BARIUM SULFATE IZ USED AS A CONTRAST AGENT IN GASTROINTESTINAL X-RAYS!

Hf.name: HAFNIUM
Hf.desc: NEARLY ALWAYS FOUND ALONGSIDE ZIRCONIUM IN NATURE DUE TA NEARLY IDENTICAL IONIC RADII. USED IN NUCLEAR CONTROL RODS AN' AS A HIGH-K DIELECTRIC IN MODERN INTEGRATED CIRCUITS!

Ta.name: TANTALUM
Ta.desc: A REFRACTORY METAL OF EXCEPTIONAL BIOCOMPATIBILITY AN' CORROSION RESISTANCE, USED IN SURGICAL IMPLANTS, CAPACITORS IN ELECTRONIC DEVICES, AN' HIGH-TEMPERATURE APPLICATIONS!

W.name: TUNGSTEN
W.desc: HAB DA HIGHEST MELTIN' POINT (3422°C) OF ANY ELEMENT, MAKIN' IT INDISPENSABLE FOR LIGHT BULB FILAMENTS, CUTTIN' TOOLS, AN' HIGH-TEMPERATURE FURNACES!

Re.name: RHENIUM
Re.desc: ONE OF DA RAREST ELEMENTS IN EARTH'S CRUST, DISCOVERED LAST AMONG STABLE ELEMENTS. CRITICAL IN SUPERALLOYS FOR SINGLE-CRYSTAL JET TURBINE BLADES DAT OPERATE NEAR DEY MELTIN' POINT!

Os.name: OSMIUM
Os.desc: DA DENSEST NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENT. FORMS AN EXTREMELY TOXIC AN' VOLATILE TETROXIDE UPON OXIDATION. ITS EXTRAORDINARY HARDNESS MAKES IT USEFUL IN SPECIALTY ALLOYS!

Ir.name: IRIDIUM
Ir.desc: DA MOST CORROSION-RESISTANT METAL KNOWN. DA ANOMALOUS IRIDIUM LAYER AT DA CRETACEOUS-PALEOGENE BOUNDARY IZ KEY EVIDENCE FOR DA ASTEROID IMPACT DAT ENDED DA DINOSAURS!

Pt.name: PLATINUM
Pt.desc: A DENSE, LUSTROUS, AN' REMARKABLY INERT METAL HIGHLY PRIZED FOR JEWELRY AN' CATALYTIC CONVERTERS. ITS CORROSION RESISTANCE AN' BIOCOMPATIBILITY ALSO MAKE IT VITAL IN MEDICAL DEVICES!

Au.name: GOLD
Au.desc: PRIZED THROUGHOUT ALL OF HUMAN HISTORY FOR ITS RARITY, WARM LUSTER, AN' COMPLETE RESISTANCE TA CORROSION. A STANDARD OF VALUE AN' BEAUTY DAT HAB DRIVEN EXPLORATION AN' WAR ALIKE!

Hg.name: MERCURY
Hg.desc: DA ONLY METAL LIQUID AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. ONCE USED WIDELY IN THERMOMETERS, BAROMETERS, AN' DENTAL FILLINGS, ITS POTENT NEUROTOXICITY HAB LED TA WIDESPREAD BANS!

Tl.name: THALLIUM
Tl.desc: A SOFT, HIGHLY TOXIC METAL DAT ONCE FOUND USE AS A RAT POISON AN' INSECTICIDE. NOW PRIMARILY USED IN SPECIALIZED INFRARED DETECTORS AN' HIGH-DENSITY GLASS!

Pb.name: LEAD
Pb.desc: DENSE, EASILY SHAPED, AN' WORKABLE SINCE ANTIQUITY. USED FOR MILLENNIA IN PIPES, PAINT, AN' AMMUNITION. ITS CUMULATIVE NEUROTOXICITY, ESPECIALLY IN CHILDREN, IZ NOW WELL ESTABLISHED!

Bi.name: BISMUTH
Bi.desc: DA HEAVIEST STABLE ELEMENT, FORMIN' SPECTACULAR IRIDESCENT CRYSTALS WIT ITS NATIVE OXIDE LAYER. USED IN COSMETICS, ALLOYS, AN' PHARMACEUTICALS; REMARKABLY NON-TOXIC FOR A HEAVY METAL!

Po.name: POLONIUM
Po.desc: HIGHLY RADIOACTIVE, DISCOVERED BY MARIE CURIE AN' NAMED FOR HER HOMELAND OF POLAND. IT EMITS INTENSE ALPHA RADIATION AN' WAZ USED AS DA TRIGGER IN EARLY ATOMIC BOMBS!

At.name: ASTATINE
At.desc: DA RAREST NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENT; ONLY TINY TRACE AMOUNTS EXIST ON EARTH AT ANY TIME, PRODUCED BY RADIOACTIVE DECAY OF URANIUM. ITS CHEMISTRY IZ ONLY BEGINNIN' TA BE UNDERSTOOD!

Rn.name: RADON
Rn.desc: A RADIOACTIVE NOBLE GAS PRODUCED BY DA NATURAL DECAY OF URANIUM AN' RADIUM IN SOIL AN' ROCK. SEEPIN' INTO BUILDINGS, IT IZ DA SECOND LEADIN' CAUSE OF LUNG CANCER AFTER SMOKIN'!

Fr.name: FRANCIUM
Fr.desc: DA SECOND RAREST NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENT, FOUND ONLY AS TRANSIENT DECAY PRODUCTS. DA MOST REACTIVE AN' LEAST STABLE OF DA ALKALI METALS, IT WAZ DA LAST ELEMENT DISCOVERED IN NATURE!

Ra.name: RADIUM
Ra.desc: DISCOVERED BY MARIE AN' PIERRE CURIE IN 1898, RADIUM EMITS A FAINT BLUE-GREEN GLOW CAUSED BY ITS INTENSE RADIOACTIVITY IONIZIN' SURROUNDIN' AIR. ITS MEDICAL USE IN EARLY CANCER TREATMENT WAZ PIONEERIN' AN' DEADLY!

Rf.name: RUTHERFORDIUM
Rf.desc: DA FIRST TRANSACTINIDE ELEMENT, SYNTHESIZED BY BOMBARDIN' CALIFORNIUM WIT CARBON NUCLEI. NAMED IN HONOR OF DA PHYSICIST ERNEST RUTHERFORD, FATHER OF NUCLEAR PHYSICS!

Db.name: DUBNIUM
Db.desc: A SYNTHETIC ELEMENT NAMED AFTER DUBNA, RUSSIA, WHERE IT WAZ FIRST PRODUCED. HAB NO STABLE OR LONG-LIVED ISOTOPES AN' EXISTS ONLY IN VANISHINGLY SMALL QUANTITIES!

Sg.name: SEABORGIUM
Sg.desc: NAMED AFTER GLENN T. SEABORG, DA ONLY ELEMENT NAMED AFTER A LIVIN' PERSON AT DA TIME OF ITS DISCOVERY. SEABORG HIMSELF HELD DA PERIODIC TABLE RECORD FOR MOST ELEMENTS CO-DISCOVERED!

Bh.name: BOHRIUM
Bh.desc: NAMED AFTER DA PHYSICIST NIELS BOHR. SYNTHESIZED BY BOMBARDIN' BISMUTH WIT CHROMIUM NUCLEI; ALL KNOWN ISOTOPES HAB HALF-LIVES MEASURED IN SECONDS OR LESS!

Hs.name: HASSIUM
Hs.desc: NAMED AFTER HESSE, DA GERMAN STATE WHERE IT WAZ FIRST CREATED AT GSI. DA HEAVIEST ELEMENT WHOSE CHEMICAL PROPERTIES HAB BEEN EXPERIMENTALLY CONFIRMED!

Mt.name: MEITNERIUM
Mt.desc: NAMED IN HONOR OF LISE MEITNER, DA PHYSICIST WHO PIONEERED NUCLEAR FISSION RESEARCH YET WAZ CONTROVERSIALLY EXCLUDED FROM DA NOBEL PRIZE AWARDED TA HER COLLABORATOR!

Ds.name: DARMSTADTIUM
Ds.desc: NAMED AFTER DA CITY OF DARMSTADT, GERMANY, HOME OF DA GSI HEAVY ION RESEARCH FACILITY WHERE IT WAZ FIRST SYNTHESIZED IN 1994!

Rg.name: ROENTGENIUM
Rg.desc: NAMED AFTER WILHELM RÖNTGEN, DISCOVERER OF X-RAYS. A SYNTHETIC ELEMENT WIT ONLY SHORT-LIVED ISOTOPES, FIRST CREATED AT GSI BY BOMBARDIN' BISMUTH WIT NICKEL IONS!

Cn.name: COPERNICIUM
Cn.desc: NAMED AFTER NICOLAUS COPERNICUS. THEORETICAL CALCULATIONS PREDICT IT MAY BEHAVE MORE LIKE A NOBLE GAS DEN A METAL AT ROOM TEMPERATURE DUE TA RELATIVISTIC EFFECTS!

Nh.name: NIHONIUM
Nh.desc: DA FIRST ELEMENT DISCOVERED IN ASIA, SYNTHESIZED AT RIKEN IN JAPAN. ITS NAME DERIVES FROM 'NIHON', DA JAPANESE WORD FOR JAPAN, MEANIN' 'LAND OF DA RISIN' SUN'!

Fl.name: FLEROVIUM
Fl.desc: NAMED AFTER DA FLEROV LABORATORY OF NUCLEAR REACTIONS IN DUBNA. PREDICTED BY RELATIVISTIC CALCULATIONS TA HAB UNUSUAL CHEMICAL PROPERTIES, POSSIBLY BEHAVIN' AS A NOBLE GAS!

Mc.name: MOSCOVIUM
Mc.desc: NAMED AFTER MOSCOW OBLAST, WHERE DA JOINT INSTITUTE FOR NUCLEAR RESEARCH, ITS PLACE OF DISCOVERY, IZ LOCATED. PRODUCED BY BOMBARDIN' AMERICIUM WIT CALCIUM IONS!

Lv.name: LIVERMORIUM
Lv.desc: NAMED JOINTLY AFTER LAWRENCE LIVERMORE NATIONAL LABORATORY IN CALIFORNIA AN' AFTER DUBNA. FIRST SYNTHESIZED BY A US-RUSSIAN COLLABORATION BY BOMBARDIN' CURIUM WIT CALCIUM!

Ts.name: TENNESSINE
Ts.desc: NAMED AFTER TENNESSEE, HONORIN' VANDERBILT UNIVERSITY, DA UNIVERSITY OF TENNESSEE, AN' OAK RIDGE NATIONAL LABORATORY, ALL CRUCIAL CONTRIBUTORS TA SUPERHEAVY ELEMENT RESEARCH!

Og.name: OGANESSON
Og.desc: NAMED AFTER NUCLEAR PHYSICIST YURI OGANESSIAN, A PIONEER IN SUPERHEAVY ELEMENT SYNTHESIS. DA HEAVIEST KNOWN ELEMENT, IT IZ EXPECTED TA HAB PROPERTIES REAL DIFFERENT FROM LIGHTER NOBLE GASES!

La.name: LANTHANUM
La.desc: A SOFT, SILVERY-WHITE METAL DAT GIVES ITS NAME TA DA ENTIRE LANTHANIDE SERIES. USED IN CAMERA AN' TELESCOPE LENS GLASS, CATALYTIC CRACKIN' OF OIL, AN' HYDROGEN STORAGE!

Ce.name: CERIUM
Ce.desc: DA MOST ABUNDANT RARE EARTH ELEMENT. USED IN CATALYTIC CONVERTERS FOR PETROLEUM REFININ', AS A GLASS POLISHIN' COMPOUND, AN' IN DA SELF-CLEANIN' COATIN' OF OVENS!

Pr.name: PRASEODYMIUM
Pr.desc: ITS SALTS PRODUCE A DISTINCTIVE APPLE-GREEN COLOR AN' IZ USED IN PROTECTIVE GOGGLES FOR GLASSBLOWERS. COMBINED WIT NEODYMIUM IT FORMS POWERFUL PERMANENT MAGNETS!

Nd.name: NEODYMIUM
Nd.desc: USED IN DA WORLD'S STRONGEST PERMANENT MAGNETS, FOUND IN HARD DRIVES, HEADPHONES, AN' ELECTRIC MOTORS. ITS MAGNETS IZ FUNDAMENTAL TA MODERN WIND TURBINES AN' ELECTRIC VEHICLES!

Pm.name: PROMETHIUM
Pm.desc: DA ONLY RARE EARTH ELEMENT WIT NO STABLE ISOTOPES, NAMED AFTER DA TITAN PROMETHEUS WHO STOLE FIRE FROM DA GODS. PRODUCED ONLY IN NUCLEAR REACTORS AN' SUPERNOVAE!

Sm.name: SAMARIUM
Sm.desc: FORMS SAMARIUM-COBALT MAGNETS DAT RETAIN DEY PROPERTIES AT HIGH TEMPERATURES FAR EXCEEDIN' DA LIMITS OF NEODYMIUM MAGNETS. ALSO USED IN CANCER TREATMENT AN' AS A NEUTRON ABSORBER!

Eu.name: EUROPIUM
Eu.desc: PROVIDES DA BRILLIANT RED AN' BLUE PHOSPHORS IN TELEVISION SCREENS AN' FLUORESCENT LAMPS. INCORPORATED INTO EURO BANKNOTES UNDER UV-RESPONSIVE INK AS A SECURITY FEATURE!

Gd.name: GADOLINIUM
Gd.desc: HAB DA HIGHEST MAGNETIC MOMENT OF ANY ELEMENT AT ROOM TEMPERATURE. WIDELY USED AS A PARAMAGNETIC CONTRAST AGENT IN MRI SCANS TA ENHANCE VISIBILITY OF LESIONS!

Tb.name: TERBIUM
Tb.desc: USED AS A GREEN PHOSPHOR IN FLUORESCENT LAMPS AN' IN MAGNETOSTRICTIVE ALLOYS DAT CHANGE SHAPE IN A MAGNETIC FIELD. ALSO ESSENTIAL IN SOME SOLID-STATE LASER SYSTEMS!

Dy.name: DYSPROSIUM
Dy.desc: ITS GREEK NAME MEANS 'HARD TA GET AT'. AN ESSENTIAL ADDITIVE IN NEODYMIUM MAGNETS TA MAINTAIN DEY STRENGTH AT ELEVATED TEMPERATURES IN ELECTRIC VEHICLE MOTORS!

Ho.name: HOLMIUM
Ho.desc: HAB DA HIGHEST MAGNETIC MOMENT OF ANY NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENT, MAKIN' IT USEFUL IN DA POLE PIECES OF REAL STRONG MAGNETS AN' IN SPECIALIZED LASER SURGERY!

Er.name: ERBIUM
Er.desc: USED AS A SIGNAL AMPLIFIER DOPANT IN FIBER OPTIC CABLES (ERBIUM-DOPED FIBER AMPLIFIERS) DAT UNDERPIN INTERCONTINENTAL TELECOMMUNICATIONS. ALSO USED IN MEDICAL LASERS!

Tm.name: THULIUM
Tm.desc: DA LEAST ABUNDANT AN' SECOND HEAVIEST STABLE LANTHANIDE. USED IN PORTABLE X-RAY DEVICES AS A RADIATION SOURCE WHEN IRRADIATED IN A NUCLEAR REACTOR, EMITTIN' USEFUL GAMMA RAYS!

Yb.name: YTTERBIUM
Yb.desc: NAMED AFTER YTTERBY, SWEDEN. IMPROVES DA GRAIN REFINEMENT AN' STRENGTH OF STAINLESS STEEL, AN' SERVES AS A DOPANT IN FIBER LASERS AN' OPTICAL ATOMIC CLOCKS OF EXTRAORDINARY PRECISION!

Lu.name: LUTETIUM
Lu.desc: DA HEAVIEST AN' HARDEST OF DA LANTHANIDES. USED AS A CATALYST IN PETROLEUM REFININ', IN PET SCAN DETECTORS, AN' IN RADIOIMMUNOTHERAPY FOR CERTAIN CANCERS!

Ac.name: ACTINIUM
Ac.desc: DA FIRST MEMBER OF DA ACTINIDE SERIES, HIGHLY RADIOACTIVE. ITS INTENSE ALPHA EMISSION CAUSES IT TA GLOW A PALE BLUE IN DA DARK AS IT IONIZES DA SURROUNDIN' AIR. USED IN TARGETED CANCER THERAPY!

Th.name: THORIUM
Th.desc: THREE TIMES MORE ABUNDANT DEN URANIUM, THORIUM IZ A POTENTIAL NUCLEAR FUEL. OCCURS NATURALLY IN MONAZITE SAND AN' WAZ ONCE USED IN INCANDESCENT GAS MANTLES FOR ITS BRILLIANT WHITE GLOW!

Pa.name: PROTACTINIUM
Pa.desc: ONE OF DA RAREST AN' MOST TOXIC NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENTS. A RADIOACTIVE DECAY PRODUCT OF URANIUM-235, IT POSES SEVERE HEALTH HAZARDS AN' HAB NO COMMERCIAL APPLICATIONS!

U.name: URANIUM
U.desc: DA HEAVIEST NATURALLY OCCURRIN' ELEMENT AN' DA PRIMARY FUEL OF NUCLEAR REACTORS. ITS FISSION RELEASES MILLIONS OF TIMES MORE ENERGY DEN CHEMICAL COMBUSTION PER GRAM!

Np.name: NEPTUNIUM
Np.desc: DA FIRST SYNTHETIC TRANSURANIUM ELEMENT, PRODUCED IN A CYCLOTRON IN 1940 AN' NAMED AFTER DA PLANET NEPTUNE. TRACE AMOUNTS OCCUR NATURALLY AS A DECAY PRODUCT OF URANIUM!

Pu.name: PLUTONIUM
Pu.desc: PRODUCED FROM URANIUM IN NUCLEAR REACTORS, PLUTONIUM IZ DA PRIMARY FISSILE MATERIAL IN NUCLEAR WEAPONS. ONE KILOGRAM OF PLUTONIUM-239 CONTAINS DA ENERGY EQUIVALENT OF THOUSANDS OF TONS OF TNT!

Am.name: AMERICIUM
Am.desc: A SYNTHETIC TRANSURANIC ELEMENT FOUND IN EVERY HOUSEHOLD IONIZATION SMOKE DETECTOR. NAMED AFTER DA AMERICAS, IT EMITS ALPHA PARTICLES DAT IONIZE AIR TA COMPLETE DA DETECTOR'S SENSIN' CIRCUIT!

Cm.name: CURIUM
Cm.desc: NAMED AFTER MARIE AN' PIERRE CURIE. ITS INTENSE RADIOACTIVITY CAUSES IT TA GLOW A SOFT BLUE-WHITE IN DA DARK. USED AS A POWER SOURCE IN THERMOELECTRIC GENERATORS ON DEEP SPACE PROBES!

Bk.name: BERKELIUM
Bk.desc: NAMED AFTER BERKELEY, CALIFORNIA. PRODUCED ONLY IN MICROGRAM QUANTITIES AN' HAB NO PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS OUTSIDE OF NUCLEAR RESEARCH AN' DA SYNTHESIS OF HEAVIER ELEMENTS!

Cf.name: CALIFORNIUM
Cf.desc: NAMED AFTER CALIFORNIA. AN INTENSE NEUTRON EMITTER USED AS A PORTABLE NEUTRON SOURCE FOR NUCLEAR STARTUP RODS, NEUTRON ACTIVATION ANALYSIS, AN' CANCER TREATMENT!

Es.name: EINSTEINIUM
Es.desc: NAMED AFTER ALBERT EINSTEIN. FIRST DETECTED IN 1952 IN DA FALLOUT OF DA FIRST THERMONUCLEAR BOMB TEST, PRODUCED BY INTENSE NEUTRON BOMBARDMENT OF URANIUM-238!

Fm.name: FERMIUM
Fm.desc: NAMED AFTER ENRICO FERMI. ALSO FIRST DETECTED IN NUCLEAR BOMB FALLOUT. CAN ONLY BE PRODUCED IN NANOGRAM QUANTITIES IN HIGH-FLUX NUCLEAR REACTORS; NO PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS!

Md.name: MENDELEVIUM
Md.desc: NAMED AFTER DMITRI MENDELEEV, DA CREATOR OF DA PERIODIC TABLE. FIRST PRODUCED BY BOMBARDIN' EINSTEINIUM WIT ALPHA PARTICLES; ONLY A FEW ATOMS IZ MADE AT A TIME!

No.name: NOBELIUM
No.desc: NAMED AFTER ALFRED NOBEL, INVENTOR OF DYNAMITE AN' FOUNDER OF DA NOBEL PRIZES. FIRST UNAMBIGUOUSLY IDENTIFIED IN 1958; ALL ISOTOPES HAB SHORT HALF-LIVES!

Lr.name: LAWRENCIUM
Lr.desc: DA LAST OF DA ACTINIDE SERIES, NAMED AFTER ERNEST O. LAWRENCE, INVENTOR OF DA CYCLOTRON. ITS CHEMISTRY HAB ONLY RECENTLY BEEN STUDIED DUE TA DA EXTREME DIFFICULTY OF PRODUCIN' IT!

My.name: MYTHRIL
My.desc: A LEGENDARY SILVER METAL LIGHTER DEN SILK YET STRONGER DEN TEMPERED STEEL, FOUND ONLY IN DA DEEPEST DWARVEN MINES FAR BELOW DA ROOTS OF ANCIENT MOUNTAINS. ITS MOLECULAR STRUCTURE SEEMS TA DEFY CONVENTIONAL PHYSICS, MAINTAININ' PERFECT CRYSTALLINE ORDER INDEFINITELY WHILE REMAININ' MALLEABLE UNDER DA HAMMER OF A MASTER SMITH!

Ad.name: ADAMANTINE
Ad.desc: DA HARDEST SUBSTANCE KNOWN TA MAGIC OR SCIENCE, CRYSTALLIZED FROM DA COMPRESSED BONES OF PRIMORDIAL DRAGONS OVER MILLIONS OF YEARS OF GEOLOGICAL PRESSURE. NO CONVENTIONAL FORCE CAN SCRATCH OR DEFORM IT; ONLY DIRECT DRAGON-FIRE AT FULL BREATH OR AN ACT OF DIVINE WILL IZ SAID TA BE CAPABLE OF RESHAPIN' DIS MATERIAL!

Ae.name: AETHER
Ae.desc: PURE MAGICAL ENERGY CONDENSED INTO A CRYSTALLINE LATTICE, LUMINOUS BEYOND DA VISIBLE SPECTRUM AN' DETECTABLE ONLY THROUGH ARCANE SIGHT OR EXTREME SENSITIVITY TA LEY FIELDS. IT IZ DA MEDIUM THROUGH WHICH ALL SPELLS PROPAGATE, DA INVISIBLE RIVER ON WHICH EVERY ENCHANTMENT FLOWS FROM MIND TA MANIFESTATION!

Vd.name: VOIDITE
Vd.desc: MATTER HARVESTED FROM DA NULL-SPACE BETWEEN PLANES OF EXISTENCE, SO DARK IT RENDERS DA SPACE AROUND IT VISUALLY INDETERMINATE, AN' COLD FAR BEYOND ABSOLUTE ZERO. ANY ENERGY DAT CONTACTS IT IZ ABSORBED COMPLETELY: LIGHT, HEAT AN' MAGIC ALIKE. DAT MAKES IT INVALUABLE FOR CERTAIN FORBIDDEN RITUALS AN' EXTRAORDINARILY LETHAL TA CONTAIN WITHOUT DA PROPER WARDIN' GLYPHS!

Sl.name: SOULITE
Sl.desc: CRYSTALLIZED ESSENCE OF LIVIN' SOULS, FORMED ONLY AT NEXUSES WHERE DA SPIRITUAL ENERGY OF THOUSANDS OF DEATHS HAB POOLED AN' SOLIDIFIED OVER CENTURIES INTO TRANSLUCENT, ROSE-TINTED FRAGMENTS. EACH PIECE HUMS WIT A FAINT PERSISTENT EMOTION, DA LAST FEELIN' OF WHATEVER CONSCIOUSNESS CONTRIBUTED ITS VITAL FORCE TA DA CRYSTAL'S FORMATION!

Dc.name: DRACITE
Dc.desc: A DEEP CRIMSON MINERAL FOUND ONLY IN DA HEARTS OF DEAD ELDER DRAGONS, WHERE DA CONCENTRATED DRACONIC FIRE DAT SUSTAINED DEM FOR MILLENNIA HAB TRANSMUTED DEY INNERMOST BONES INTO SOMETHIN' BEYOND BONE OR METAL. WEAPONS AN' ARMOR CRAFTED FROM IT RETAIN DA FURY OF DA CREATURE FROM WHICH IT CAME, NEVER COOLIN', NEVER DULLIN'!

Ma.name: MANAITE
Ma.desc: DA SOLIDIFIED FORM OF RAW MAGICAL FORCE, FOUND IN SMALL DEPOSITS AT CONVERGENCE POINTS OF LEYLINES DEEP UNDERGROUND, WHERE AMBIENT MAGICAL ENERGY HAB CRYSTALLIZED UNDER IMMENSE PRESSURE OVER ARCANE AGES. IT STORES AN' AMPLIFIES ANY SPELL CAST IN ITS PROXIMITY, AN' IN SUFFICIENT QUANTITY CAN SUSTAIN AN ENCHANTMENT INDEFINITELY WITHOUT AN EXTERNAL POWER SOURCE!

Sh.name: SCHRÖDINGERITE
Sh.desc: SCRAPED IN FLAKES OFF DA ACCRETION SHELF AT DA EVENT HORIZON OF A SUPERMASSIVE BLACK HOLE, WHERE DA TIDAL GRADIENT STRETCHES DA BOUNDARY BETWEEN ONE OUTCOME AN' DA NEXT UNTIL IT TEARS OPEN. EVERY OTHER KNOWN SUBSTANCE CAN PUT ONLY PARTICLES INTO SUPERPOSITION; SCHRÖDINGERITE DOES IT TA WHOLE OBJECTS, SPLITTIN' A KEY, A DOOR OR A CORPSE INTO TWO COHERENT QUANTUM STATES DAT SIT SIDE BY SIDE UNTIL SOMETHIN' OBSERVES DEM. HANDLERS IZ WARNED DAT DA SAMPLE IZ BOTH IN DA VIAL AN' NOT IN DA VIAL, AN' DAT OPENIN' DA VIAL IZ WHAT DECIDES WHICH OF DA TWO DAYS DEY HAB BEEN LIVIN'!
